title: Apple AirPods Max 2 Are $100 Off Right Now. Let the Rationalizing Begin
gist: Wired deal piece: Apple AirPods Max 2 are $100 off at $449 and AirPods Pro 3 are $49 off at about $200, with likely deeper Black Friday drops.

insights.claim: Apple AirPods Max 2 are $449 on Amazon, $100 off the $549 list, and $499 at Best Buy, although Wired has seen lower prices and expects further drops for Black Friday.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Discounts on flagship Apple audio are recurring; Black Friday is the next price trough.

insights.claim: AirPods Pro 3 are $199 on Amazon, 20 percent off the $249 list, and the reviewer advises waiting for Black Friday unless a purchase is urgent.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Timing buyers' demand into Black Friday may shift Q4 promotional sell-through.

insights.claim: AirPods Max 2 deliver up to 1.5 times more ANC than the prior version, support lossless audio, and can be plugged in via USB-C for ultralow latency; owners of the original need not upgrade.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Incremental upgrade; limited replacement-cycle pull from existing owners.
insights.locator: The AirPods Max 2 are the best-sounding headphones

insights.claim: AirPods Pro 3 offer three times more ANC than prior models, built-in heart-rate sensing, adaptive EQ and hearing aid features, about eight hours of battery with ANC and up to 24 with the case.
insights.speaker: Boutayna Chokrane
insights.so_what: Health and hearing features extend Apple's wearables into health.
